title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-jjhj: schc/fragment.rs missing constants TILE_SIZE, WINDOW_SIZE, BITMAP_MASK, MAX_PACKET_SIZE, RULE_ID_A_TO_B, RULE_ID_B_TO_A
description: These 6 constants are referenced throughout fragment.rs but never defined anywhere. Affects: write_to validation, Ack bitmap logic, FragmentSender/FragmentReceiver byte-level arithmetic, window/finalize checks. File has 65 compile errors; all of these constants were used but undefined even in parent commit f72b273558. They were likely defined in an earlier version and lost during a refactor/rename. Likely values needed: TILE_SIZE = 18 (matching python/test vectors), WINDOW_SIZE = 62 (matches MAX_WINDOW_SIZE per RFC 8724 Ack-on-Error), BITMAP_MASK must cover WINDOW_SIZE bits for window tracking, MAX_PACKET_SIZE cap on reassembly, RULE_ID_A_TO_B/RULE_ID_B_TO_A = specific rule IDs for frag send/receive matching rules.rs.
